limitations: AI scoring is provisional; no independent qualified lawyer reviewed these results.
Exact runtime model/version was not exposed and is recorded as unavailable.
Candidate skills were read and executed in isolated Codex subagent sessions, not installed and discovered through a production plugin host.
Offline mode was instructed; retrieval tools were not technically removed. Session evidence reports no retrieval or external actions.
tool_calls.md is a session-produced request/result summary, not an independently exported full raw transcript.
Synthetic/offline suite does not validate current Vietnamese law or satisfy the five-category live acceptance gate.
execution_note: 22 isolated final invocations, no answer key supplied to tested agents. Six initial invocations with extraneous fixtures were excluded and rerun with clean inputs. Original repository unchanged. No candidate fixes or deployment performed.
